sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which part of your hand should you primarily use to grip a ball securely when throwing it over a long distance?
options: A) The center of your palm
B) Your fingertips and base of fingers
C) Only the tip of your thumb
D) The back of your hand
questions.answer: B) Your fingertips and base of fingers

questions.question_text: When attempting to intercept a fast-moving ball, where should your eyes be focused?
options: A) On your teammates
B) On the opponent's feet
C) Constantly tracking the ball's path
D) On the ground in front of you
questions.answer: C) Constantly tracking the ball's path

questions.question_text: What is the correct positioning of the non-kicking foot (plant foot) when aiming to kick a ball at a specific target?
options: A) Far behind the ball
B) Pointing away from the target
C) Beside the ball, pointing directly at the target
D) In front of the ball
questions.answer: C) Beside the ball, pointing directly at the target

questions.question_text: Why do athletes use 'little steps' when preparing to receive a pass or block an opponent?
options: A) To look professional
B) To rest their leg muscles
C) To maintain balance and allow for sudden changes in direction
D) To make as much noise as possible
questions.answer: C) To maintain balance and allow for sudden changes in direction

questions.question_text: When striking a moving object with a bat or racket, what ensures maximum power is transferred?
options: A) Closing your eyes just before impact
B) A complete and smooth follow-through after the strike
C) Stopping the bat immediately after hitting
D) Holding the bat with only one hand
questions.answer: B) A complete and smooth follow-through after the strike

questions.question_text: How should your hands be positioned to successfully catch a ball dropping below your waist?
options: A) Fingers pointing up with thumbs together
B) Fingers pointing down with pinkies together
C) One hand in front of the other
D) Fists closed tight until the ball hits
questions.answer: B) Fingers pointing down with pinkies together

questions.question_text: In a tactical team game, what does it mean to 'intercept' a pass?
options: A) Throwing the ball out of bounds
B) Passing the ball to the referee
C) Catching or stealing a pass meant for an opposing player
D) Standing perfectly still while the ball goes past
questions.answer: C) Catching or stealing a pass meant for an opposing player

questions.question_text: What is the best body stance to quickly accelerate forward during a match?
options: A) Standing completely straight with locked knees
B) Leaning backward with hands on hips
C) Knees slightly bent, weight on the balls of the feet
D) Sitting on the ground
questions.answer: C) Knees slightly bent, weight on the balls of the feet

questions.question_text: When tracking a high-flying ball, how should you move your body?
options: A) Walk backwards slowly
B) Turn sideways and run to position yourself under the ball
C) Jump blindly into the air
D) Wait for the ball to bounce first
questions.answer: B) Turn sideways and run to position yourself under the ball

questions.question_text: Which action best demonstrates good tactical footwork in defense?
options: A) Crossing your legs while running
B) Dragging your feet on the ground
C) Shuffling side-to-side without crossing your feet
D) Standing flat-footed
questions.answer: C) Shuffling side-to-side without crossing your feet

questions.question_text: Describe the correct physical posture your arms and hands should maintain right before catching a high-flying ball. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Extend your arms upward with elbows slightly bent. Keep your hands open close together, creating a cup shape, with fingers spread out wide to receive the ball safely.

questions.question_text: Explain the proper foot placement required to accurately kick a ball towards a specific target. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Place your non-kicking foot firmly beside the ball, pointing directly at your target. Strike the center of the ball securely with the inside of your kicking foot.

questions.question_text: Why is a 'follow-through' motion important when striking a ball with a racket or bat? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A proper follow-through ensures maximum power is smoothly transferred to the ball. It also helps control the overall direction of the strike and maintains your body's balance.

questions.question_text: How do 'little steps' help a defender anticipate an opponent's sudden movements on the field? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Taking quick, little steps keeps you light on your toes. This allows you to instantly shift your body weight and change direction to block dodging opponents.

questions.question_text: What physical actions must a player take to successfully intercept an opponent's pass? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Keep your eyes locked on the ball and anticipate its path. Sprint into the open space ahead of the intended receiver and block the ball with outstretched hands.

questions.question_text: Imagine tracking a fast-moving ball in the outfield. Describe your body's specific movements to get into a safe catching position. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would immediately focus my eyes on the ball's trajectory while taking quick little steps backward. I would position my body directly underneath the dropping ball, bend my knees slightly for stability, and raise both hands up to form a secure catching cup.

questions.question_text: Imagine setting up to strike a moving ball with a hockey stick or cricket bat. Describe your initial stance and grip. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would stand sideways to the bowler with my feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. My hands would grip the handle firmly, one directly above the other. I would keep my head perfectly still, eyes glued to the ball, ready to swing.

questions.question_text: Explain the complete kinetic chain of physical movements required to perform a powerful and accurate overhand throw. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Begin by standing sideways to your target and stepping forward with your opposite foot. Rotate your hips and torso powerfully toward the target. Bring your throwing arm forward, release the ball at the highest point, and let your arm follow through naturally across your body to maximize throwing speed.

questions.question_text: Describe how taking quick little steps and maintaining a low center of gravity heavily improves a player's agility and defensive tactical positioning. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Maintaining a low center of gravity by bending the knees keeps your body highly stable. Combining this with quick little steps allows you to react instantly to an opponent's movements. You can pivot, accelerate, or stop suddenly, making your defensive tactical positioning incredibly effective during high-speed sports matches.
